info.title: Tellurion — OGC API Features
info.description: OGC API — Common (Core, landing page, conformance, OpenAPI) plus Features Part 1 (Core + GeoJSON), Part 2 (CRS by Reference), Part 3 (Filtering/CQL2 and Queryables as Query Parameters), and Part 4 (Create/Replace/Update/Delete, with optimistic locking) for one catalog, alongside this server's own batch-write and change-feed resources. Mounted at /{tenant}/features/catalogs/{catalog}.

200.description: Links to the API description, conformance declaration, and data.
The OpenAPI 3.0 document describing this API.

get.summary: List the feature collections available to this tenant

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Collections per page. Values above the server maximum are clamped, not rejected.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque keyset pagination token from a previous response's `next` link.

get.summary: JSON Schema of the properties the filter parameter accepts for a collection

200.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) document describing this collection's queryable properties.

get.description: In addition to the parameters listed here, every simple-valued property this collection declares as a queryable (see the collection's own /queryables document) may also be supplied as its own ?propertyName=value query parameter, evaluated as an equality predicate and combined with any other filtering already applied (OGC API - Features Part 3, "Queryables as Query Parameters"). Per-collection parameter names are dynamic and not enumerated in this document.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Values above the server maximum are clamped, not rejected.

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: A single RFC 3339 instant, or a start/end interval with `..` for an open end (not both).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque keyset pagination token from a previous response's `next` link.

parameters.name: bbox-crs
parameters.description: The CRS `bbox`'s four numbers are expressed in (OGC API Features Part 2). Meaningful only together with `bbox`; a latitude-before-longitude CRS is axis-swapped before evaluation.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A CQL2 filter expression (OGC API Features Part 3), encoded per `filter-lang`. Requires the collection's resolved driver to support filtering, else 400.

parameters.name: filter-lang
parameters.description: Which encoding `filter` is in. Ignored when `filter` itself is absent.

post.summary: Add a new feature to a collection
post.description: OGC API Features Part 4 (Create/Replace/Delete). The server mints the feature id and returns it in the Location header; an id member in the posted feature is not authoritative. The body is validated against the collection's declared schema, when it has one, before anything is committed.

201.description: The feature was created; Location names the new feature's URI.

post.summary: Apply many caller-identified feature upserts in one paced request
post.description: This server's own bulk-write resource, layered over the same write lane the single-feature routes use. Every item is an upsert carrying its own top-level id — there is no server-assigned create and no delete here. The response is streamed newline-delimited JSON: one outcome object per item, then one terminal summary object; once the stream has started, a budget overrun, a malformed record, or a strict stop is reported in band rather than as a different HTTP status.

parameters.name: strict
parameters.description: `true` stops attempting further items at the first refusal; the already-staged items still get their own outcome lines and the unread tail is reported as unapplied.

requestBody.description: Either an RFC 8142 GeoJSON text sequence (streamed, never buffered whole) or one ordinary GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Both are capped by this collection's effective batch byte and item budgets.

200.description: A newline-delimited stream of per-item outcomes followed by one terminal summary.

get.summary: Read this collection's committed change feed
get.description: Drains the same write-lane outbox the index applier and tile-generation consumer read, as compact versioned envelopes. A collection with no resolvable outbox refuses by name with the same capability 404 every other capability-gated lane gives.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entries per page, bounded by this deployment's change-feed page-size configuration.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next` link; entries strictly after it are returned.

200.description: An object with `links` and a `changes` array of change envelopes.

get.summary: Fetch a single feature by id

put.summary: Replace (or create) one feature at a caller-chosen id
put.description: OGC API Features Part 4 (Create/Replace/Delete). The path id is authoritative. If-Match / If-Unmodified-Since are evaluated first when present (Part 4 optimistic locking), and the body is validated against the collection's declared schema, when it has one, before anything is committed.

204.description: The feature was replaced or created.

delete.description: OGC API Features Part 4 (Create/Replace/Delete), with the same optimistic-locking preconditions PUT evaluates.

patch.summary: Partially update an existing feature with JSON Merge Patch
patch.description: Applies RFC 7396 recursively. Null removes members; arrays and scalar values replace their targets. The feature id in the path is immutable and an id in the patch document is ignored.

200.description: The updated GeoJSON Feature, with ETag and Content-Crs validators.

412.description: A supplied write precondition did not match the current feature.

413.description: The merge patch exceeds the configured request body limit.

crs.name: crs
crs.description: Requested output CRS for geometry coordinates (OGC API Features Part 2, CRS by Reference), as a CRS URI the collection declares. Answered with a matching Content-Crs response header. Requires the collection's resolved driver to support CRS output, else 400.

hints.name: hints
hints.description: Comma-separated read-lane hints from this server's own closed vocabulary. Unknown tokens are dropped rather than rejected, so a typo never fails the request.

contentCrs.name: Content-Crs
contentCrs.description: The CRS the request body's coordinates are expressed in. A CRS the collection's write lane cannot reproject from is refused by name.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: Optimistic-locking precondition (OGC API Features Part 4): the current feature's ETag.

ifUnmodifiedSince.name: If-Unmodified-Since
ifUnmodifiedSince.description: Optimistic-locking precondition (OGC API Features Part 4), evaluated against the collection's declared modified column.

payloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds this collection's effective body (or batch) byte budget.

unsupportedMediaType.description: The request body's media type is not one this resource accepts.

preconditionFailed.description: A supplied write precondition did not match the current feature.

itemsVertexBudgetExceeded.description: Exact geometry was refused rather than simplified or partially returned because the selected item page exceeded the collection's configured cumulative vertex budget.

notFound.description: Unknown collection or feature, or the driver doesn't support this capability.
